title: OrganizerPhoneLeadDocument
description: Shadow organizer profiles (docs/shadow_profiles.md). Server-only index from one phone number to the unclaimed organizers it was seen with. The document id is a keyed HMAC of the E.164 number (LISTING_SUPPRESSION_HMAC_KEY under the phone-lead: namespace); no document holds the number. Entries are keyed {source}__{organizerId}. findClaimableOrganizers reads it to offer a claim to the verified owner of that number; requestOrganizerClaim reads it to mark a claim for staff. Never shown to clients. Written only while the source's switch is on (all off by default).
